description: EduStep is an innovative platform designed to empower learners and educators by providing a structured, interactive approach to education. Users can access and contribute quizzes tailored to various education levels, including Primary School, Secondary School, and SPM. The platform features AI-driven tools for quiz generation, a collaborative verification system to ensure content quality, and personalized career guidance based on user ambitions. EduStep also fosters a dynamic community by incentivizing quiz creators and verifiers while maintaining fairness through role-based permissions. With its focus on accessibility, engagement, and quality, EduStep addresses common educational challenges like inconsistent resources, outdated content, and a lack of personalized study paths. Whether you're a student aiming for academic excellence or an educator looking for effective tools, EduStep adapts to your needs and learning goals.
